verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a built-in AI chatbot for asking natural-language questions about CRM data (docs-18, docs-69). It also documents AI agents that carry out multi-step tasks, such as enriching records, within a role-based permission model (docs-5, docs-56, docs-71). Apps can extend this with custom agents and skills, including generating documents from chat (docs-66, docs-67). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of chat-driven write actions (creating or updating records and configuring views or workflows by command), coverage of how much of the product chat can operate, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
